overview: Onyx OS 95 is a Windows 95/98 themed web desktop with boot sequence, user authentication, persistent chat, and a suite of retro-inspired apps including Internet Explorer, all within a draggable windowed desktop environment.
features: Windows 95-style boot sequence with startup chime
Live Chat with persistent message history and username effects
Internet Explorer app with retro browser UI
System info showing Compaq Presario 700 specs
My Computer, Mail, Notes, Game Center, Paint apps
